value: In Shattrath, Akama places the Heart within the Medallion of Karabor and sends it to A’dal. His promise is to stand with the seeker against Illidan; this closes the first Akama chain. The medallion links Karabor’s sacred name to a dangerous plan, but its delivery does not open the raid or free Akama’s soul. The harder struggle still waits inside the Black Temple.
